conservation.condition_narrative: There is a repaired tear in the center right edge. There are numerous diagonal creases at the corners, and additional curved and linear creases throughout the paper. Printing from the verso is visible on the recto. There are inclusions in the paper support and accretions. The work is complete. There is a repaired tear in the top right. The support and media are secure. There is smudged media that appears stable. The work is evenly colored. There are accretions and inclusions in the paper. There are two areas of discolored adhesive residue visible on the top center edge of the verso. The work is mostly planar. There are significant creases at the edges and corners. The bottom edge is slightly curled upward. There are numerous creases and associated planar distortions overall. There is a repair in the right center edge. There are repairs on the verso of the crease in the upper left.
conservation.technical_description:
**Support:** The support is smooth, medium-weight, cream-colored, woven paper with straight edges and printing on the verso. 
 
 
 
**Design Layers:** Black ink from a pen, possibly a ballpoint pen. 
 
 
 
**Surface Coating:** None.
